input.quote: MSL will provide replacement value insurance coverage for consigned Products. IBM will be named as a joint insured with respect to consigned Products for its interest.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no programme-level vendor insurance covenant. The only insurance references are asset-specific or cost allocations: p0909 (replacement-value cover on consigned Products with IBM as joint insured), p1107 (IBM insures its own tooling, MSL jointly insured where possible) and p0649/p0863 (freight insurance as a price component). None requires MSL to carry commercial general liability, professional liability/E&O, workers' compensation or cyber/data coverage, so the clause falls short of even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M). MSL is an outsourced manufacturer that holds IBM inventory and tooling, operates from leased IBM premises and accesses IBM applications, networks and customer data (§ 24.1), so the rule applies and the omission is material. We propose inserting a short Section 16.22 in the General article at the preferred limits, noting the fallback in the comment.

ops.text:
16.22 Insurance

MSL shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law; and, where MSL processes IBM or IBM customer data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. MSL shall provide certificates of insurance to IBM upon request. This Section is in addition to, and does not limit, any insurance obligation of MSL elsewhere in this Agreement or its Attachments.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant: the Agreement has no programme-level coverage requirement even though MSL holds IBM inventory and tooling, works with IBM premises and accesses IBM systems and data. Limits are our standard position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where MSL processes IBM or IBM customer data); we can work with E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if needed.
proposal.summary: Insert new Section 16.22 (Insurance) requiring MSL to carry CGL, E&O, workers' compensation and cyber coverage and provide certificates.
